claims.text: The Beach side has a social, lively mood, anchored by a beach club, a taqueria and oceanfront dining.

findings.quote: The Beach is Alila's Caribbean expression where the mood is social, vibrant and anchored by a lively beach club, taqueria and oceanfront dining.
findings.note: Covers the social mood, beach club, taqueria and oceanfront dining.

claims.text: The Lagoon side is a quieter, wellness-focused retreat of mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences.

findings.quote: The Lagoon is Alila at its purest, a nature-led, wellness-focused sanctuary where mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences create a slower, quieter and more intimate retreat.
findings.note: Covers every element of the claim.

claims.text: Suites are decorated in subtle textures and soft neutrals, combining nature with sleek modern design.

findings.quote: Subtle textures and soft neutrals are a balm for the senses, combining nature with sleek modernity.
findings.note: Appears in the accommodations section describing the resort suites.

claims.text: The Beach Front Suite has a private plunge pool on its terrace.

findings.quote: The blue Caribbean beckons while you sink into the private plunge pool on the terrace of this 1,076-square-foot suite
findings.note: From the Beach Front Suite (with Plunge Pool) description.

claims.text: The Alila Beach Front Presidential Suite is a three-bedroom, two-story suite with ocean views throughout.

findings.quote: Spread out in your three-bedroom, two-story suite over 4,574 square feet, with ocean views throughout.
findings.note: From the Alila Beach Front Presidential Suite description.

claims.text: The Earth & Clay ritual centers on applying mineral-rich clay and honey.

findings.quote: This ritual centers on the application of mineral-rich clay and honey

claims.text: The Ixchel Water Blessing is a ritual using water, clay vessels, flowers and the ancestral chants of a Mayan healer.

findings.quote: Through a gentle ritual utilizing soft elements like water, clay vessels, flowers and the ancestral chants of the Mayan healer
findings.note: From the Ixchel Water Blessing description.

claims.text: Alila Moments include outings from the resort to walk among villages and ancient ruins.

findings.quote: our Alila Moments are gateways to captivating experiences. Set out from our luxury resort in Riviera Maya and walk among villages and ancient ruins.
findings.note: Covers outings from the resort to villages and ancient ruins.

claims.text: Casa Amate is a restaurant in a historic lagoon-side house that was once the residence of the De Leon family.

findings.quote: Once the residence of the De León family, this historic lagoon-side property now houses a restaurant.

claims.text: Na Cocina Local serves Yucatan cuisine from an open kitchen beside the lagoon, surrounded by mangroves.

findings.quote: Yucatán cuisine from southeastern Mexico is prepared in an open kitchen, using local ingredients, bright citrus, earthy achiote, and slow-roasted techniques. Beside the lagoon and surrounded by mangroves
findings.note: From the Na Cocina Local description.

claims.text: Alila Mayakoba is set in Mexico's Riviera Maya and combines two connected resort experiences, the Beach and the Lagoon.

findings.quote: Set in the heart of Mexico's Riviera Maya, Alila Mayakoba is defined by two distinct yet seamlessly connected luxury resort experiences.
findings.note: Establishes the location and the two connected experiences.

findings.quote: The Lagoon is Alila at its purest
findings.note: Names the Lagoon as one experience; the Beach is named in the preceding sentence.

claims.text: The Beach Front Villa spans two floors, with nature-inspired decor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.

findings.quote: Get comfortable in two floors of Mayakoba indulgence, with nature-inspired décor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.
findings.note: From the Beach Front Villa (with Plunge Pool) description.

claims.text: Wellness facilities include an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness.

findings.quote: an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness
findings.note: Covers both the temescal and the spa elements.

claims.text: With traditional healers and spiritual guides, the resort offers cenote immersions, guided ceremonies and energy cleansings rooted in Mayan spirituality.

findings.quote: Alongside traditional healers and spiritual guides, we offer destination cenote immersions, guided ceremonies, energy cleansings and more ancestral practices deeply rooted in Mayan spirituality
findings.note: Covers every element of the claim.

claims.text: The Winds of Renewal journey leads to an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing.

findings.quote: The trail unfolds into the light of an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing
findings.note: From the WINDS OF RENEWAL description.

claims.text: Winds of Renewal takes place off property.
Outdoor wellness sessions are subject to weather conditions.

findings.quote: Our outdoor sessions are subject to weather conditions.

claims.text: Guests bringing a pet should inform the hotel at least three days before arrival.

findings.quote: Please inform us that you will be bringing your pet (or pets) at least three days prior to your arrival.
